children: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said on X that AI companies should slow down their advancement efforts amid fears of misuse.
In his post, Amodei set out a three-step plan to pace development while managing risks.
"We must slow the pace at which we improve the capabilities of AI ‌models. Progress will still seem fast, and we must make wise use of the time we gain," Amodei said.
The plan includes independent evaluators to verify safety practices, coordination among AI companies to establish safety and AI development standards, and international cooperation to address risks.
CEO Sam Altman and Elon Musk responded in agreement with Amodei on X.
"Committing to having independent evaluators with employee-like access is a great idea, and we will do the same," Altman said.

"Pacing within democracies will be limited by the lead that ⁠U.S. companies have ​over authoritarian regimes, chiefly the Chinese Communist Party," Amodei added, also calling for tighter controls on AI chips against China.

title: Anthropic CEO calls for pacing AI development, setting guardrails
